name: RGBA Volume Rendering
definition: A technique to render multiple volumes by taking the value of the texture itself as the color, bypassing the colormap lookup, using a 4D array (z, y, x, 4) passed directly to the texture.
summary: RGBA Volume Rendering is a direct volume ray casting technique that uses pre-computed RGBA values directly from texture memory, bypassing traditional scalar-to-color transfer function lookups to render multiple datasets in a single pass.
